rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a sharp spike in the final bar (504K shares, price jumping from ~$11.96 to $12.04) that has pushed price to 89.6% of today's range and within 0.29% of the session high, suggesting a momentum burst that may be exhausted rather than a clean breakout setup. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.77%, VIXY +4.34%), which creates headwinds for a long, while the stock is already extended above VWAP ($11.98) and the 9-EMA ($11.88), making a short entry risky against the recent surge. With no clear consolidation or retest to define a low-risk entry point in either direction, the evidence does not support a favorable risk/reward trade at this moment.
